# `Browser.Battery`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Battery — read the device battery status over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests a status (`status` one-shot or a
continuous `watch`), and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the reply — a decoded
`Status` or a typed unavailability. Both cross the same seal codec and
fail-closed port discipline as every other port; there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses `js-port:battery`
(import-derived, keyed on the canonical `Ipe.Browser.Battery` path prefix via
`WebCapability::for_browser_module`, alias-immune); only the top-level app's
`[capabilities] accepts` set can grant it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Battery.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `status` returns a `Task Error Status`
    via the correlated port→Task bridge; `watch` is `Cmd`-shaped, and `readings`
    is the inbound subscription folding the narrow `JsMsg` into a typed
    `Result Error Status`. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE: an unavailability
    becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped variant.

## `Status`

A battery status snapshot.

  * `charging` — whether the battery is currently charging.
  * `level` — the charge fraction, `0.0`..`1.0`.
  * `chargingTime` — seconds until fully charged; a negative value means "never"
    (the Web API's `Infinity`).
  * `dischargingTime` — seconds until empty; a negative value means "never".

## `status`

```ipe
status : Task Error Status
```

`status` — read the current battery status ONCE, as a `Task Error Status`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). The reply — a `Status` or a
typed unavailability — resolves the `Task` directly; no companion subscription
is needed.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:battery`; the app must grant it with
`accepts = [ JsPort Battery ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a CONTINUOUS status stream; each change event delivers a
fresh reading on the `readings` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `readings`

```ipe
readings : (Result Error Status -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`readings toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error Status` — a `Reading` becomes `Ok`, an unavailability a typed `Err`.
